collection_summary.method: Trend opportunity analysis → concept generation → weighted concept ranking → demand forecast → inventory recommendation

product.name: Splitline Coat
product.description: A long narrow coat divided vertically into two subtly different constructions, one structured and one fluid.
product.materials: cashmere blend, silk lining, leather trim
product.colors: camel, dark brown, electric blue lining
product.design_innovation: Dual construction in one continuous silhouette.
product.whitespace_reason: Introduces conceptual asymmetry without becoming costume-like.

trend_intelligence.why_ai_thinks_this_matters: Strong momentum combined with high brand fit and clear room for new tailoring concepts.
trend_intelligence.why_product_matches_trend: Directly translates deconstructed tailoring into a commercially familiar outerwear format.

products.image_prompt:
Create a highly original luxury fashion concept image.

IMPORTANT:
This is a speculative concept study.
Do NOT copy or closely resemble any existing Hermes product.
Do NOT create a simple recolor, standard seasonal variation,
or obvious version of a product already common in luxury fashion.

CATEGORY:
Ready-to-Wear

PRODUCT NAME:
Splitline Coat

CORE PRODUCT IDEA:
A long narrow coat divided vertically into two subtly different constructions, one structured and one fluid.

DESIGN INNOVATION:
Dual construction in one continuous silhouette.

WHY THIS IS WHITESPACE:
Introduces conceptual asymmetry without becoming costume-like.

KEY MATERIALS:
cashmere blend, silk lining, leather trim

COLOR DIRECTION:
camel, dark brown, electric blue lining

PRIMARY TREND:
Deconstructed Tailoring

SECONDARY TREND:
Narrow Silhouettes

CREATIVE REQUIREMENTS:
- invent a distinctive new silhouette
- create an unexpected but functional construction
- make the product recognizable from its shape alone
- explore unusual proportion, folding, suspension, transformation,
  asymmetry, modularity, or spatial structure where appropriate
- preserve sophisticated luxury craftsmanship
- remain physically plausible and manufacturable
- avoid gimmicks
- avoid generic minimalist luxury design
- avoid common Zara-style or mass-market silhouettes
- avoid recognizable iconic luxury-product shapes
- no logos
- no monograms
- no text

VISUAL PRESENTATION:
- fashion concept editorial
- photorealistic
- premium studio photography
- strong three-dimensional form
- clearly show the innovative construction
- subtle shadows
- minimal neutral background
- extremely detailed materials and craftsmanship

The final object should feel like something a major luxury creative
director could plausibly propose for a future runway collection,
while still looking genuinely new.

product.name: Arc Volume
product.description: A sculptural leather handbag with a compressed base and expandable curved upper body.
product.materials: calfskin, suede interior, polished metal hardware
product.design_innovation: Controlled expansion changes both capacity and silhouette.
product.whitespace_reason: Creates a new volume language rather than reworking a known bag shape.

trend_intelligence.why_ai_thinks_this_matters: High visual impact and strong momentum, best used as a directional accent rather than a core heritage color.
trend_intelligence.why_product_matches_trend: Selective volume supports sculptural expansion while electric blue gives directional impact.

product.name: Layer Wallet
product.description: A slim wallet composed of overlapping leather planes that open in different directions.
product.whitespace_reason: Transforms wallet architecture instead of changing only color or hardware.

trend_intelligence.why_ai_thinks_this_matters: Small leather goods allow experimentation with emerging color and structural ideas at lower commercial risk.
trend_intelligence.why_product_matches_trend: Deconstruction translates naturally into separated functional layers.

product.name: Needle Line Boot
product.description: A narrow-profile ankle boot with a sharply elongated upper and a broken seam structure.
product.design_innovation: Elongated narrow architecture with displaced seam construction.
product.whitespace_reason: Feels modern through proportion rather than excessive ornamentation.

trend_intelligence.why_ai_thinks_this_matters: Refined narrow proportions align well with a luxury design language while leaving room for new construction.
trend_intelligence.why_product_matches_trend: Narrow silhouettes and deconstructed tailoring directly support the shape and seam logic.

product.name: Soft Form Belt
product.description: A belt with a softly inflated leather section that creates controlled volume around the waist.
product.design_innovation: Combines belt function with subtle sculptural body shaping.
product.whitespace_reason: Reimagines the belt as part of silhouette construction.

trend_intelligence.why_ai_thinks_this_matters: Accessories are a good space to test newer proportions and softer seasonal color signals.
trend_intelligence.why_product_matches_trend: Selective volume and soft seasonal color support a directional but wearable accessory.
